method: Per-site audit of effective shell semantics in every declared workflow/composite action. Each runner/tee site was checked for its enclosing run block's pipefail/status propagation; effective failure propagation was reproduced with `bash -c 'set -o pipefail; false | tee /dev/null'` (exit 1) versus plain `bash -c 'false | tee /dev/null'` (exit 0), matching GitHub's default `bash -e {0}`. No grep-only conclusions; fixes applied only where masking was proven.

sites.fix: lint job (L249), fast-shard map (L267) and shard-reduce aggregate boundary (L1208) use explicit `shell: bash` with `set -o pipefail`; all tee pipelines propagate test exit; result-truth verifier invoked at aggregate boundary before proof-bundle publication.

sites.note: All four tee sites (L110/168/213/375) sit in run blocks opened with `set -euo pipefail` (L95/163/208/367); default `bash -e` plus pipefail propagates racket failures through tee.

Tee sites (L72/154/157/167) write fallback-cause records after a deliberately handled validator/lookup failure; the fallback path always runs the full suite, so a recorded fallback message cannot mask a required failure. Enclosing block `set -euo pipefail` (L50/61).
Each of the five tee pipelines is immediately preceded by `set -o pipefail` (L84-104).
Smoke tee site (L227) inside block with `set -o pipefail` (L220); blocks at L186/L432 use `set -euo pipefail`.
Report-only telemetry job; run block `set -o pipefail` (L107); tee sites L109/118/125/133. Step outcome is report-only by design (upstream gate failure is recorded and skips plan build explicitly).
Shadow lane tee sites (L177/184) under `set -o pipefail` (L173); lane failures propagate.
No tee sites; run block `set -euo pipefail` (L51).
Four run blocks contain no pipelines; nothing for a default shell to mask.
Explicit `shell: bash` on every run step; no pipelines.
Composite action: every run step declares `shell: bash` with pipefail-safe blocks; no pipelines.
All run steps `shell: bash`; no pipelines.

unlisted_sites_gap: Repository-wide scan of .github/workflows/*.yml and .github/actions/*/action.yml found no additional runner/tee site outside the declared file list except .github/workflows/project-automation.yml and .github/actions/install-racket-runtime/action.yml, both with no pipeline/tee masking surface (project-automation: no run pipelines; install-racket-runtime: explicit shell: bash steps, no pipes). Recorded here per the audit-and-fix rule; no silent omission.
masked_historical_artifacts: v1.00.29-era fast-suite proof bundles and required-check greens produced before this fix are recorded as MASKED in baseline.json; they are diagnostic only and are NOT relabeled green or reused as safety evidence.
